textLines: Coordinate larger pieces of work across multiple people and teams. Move seamlessly between ideation and execution.
Close the gap between planning and building
Consolidate project specs, documents, issues, customer feedback, and updates in one centralized location.
Highlight key dates and map out critical paths between projects to streamline resource allocation and execution.
Understand how your project is progressing and when it’s likely to complete, with scope and velocity visualized over time.

On track | julian posted an update
We are ready to launch next Thursday
Is the marketing release page ready too?
Yes, we are putting the final touches to it this week
...even if they are not in Linear
Automatically share project updates on Slack with bi-directionally synced comment threads.
Collaborate on ideas and spec out product requirements in realtime, multiplayer project documents.
WORK TOGETHER ON PRDS, SPECS, AND DOCS IN A REALTIME, MULTIPLAYER EDITOR
DISCUSS IDEAS DIRECTLY IN CONTEXT WITH COMMENTS TIED TO SPECIFIC SECTIONS
SEAMLESSLY TURN BULLET POINT LISTS INTO ACTIONABLE ISSUES
GET NOTIFIED WHEN DOCUMENTS CHANGE, WITH CLEAR DIFFS AND NEW COMMENTS
We reviewed the latest UI refresh designs
for the rider app, focusing on core screens and perceived performance. The direction is solid
, but several areas need iteration before implementation, with Android-specific constraints currently posing the biggest risk to timeline.
Finalize loading and empty states for core screens
Align Android layouts with the design system
Finalize loading and empty states for core screens
Align Android layouts with the design system
With the public holiday next Wednesday, we’ll regroup the week after to continue the review.
Align projects into larger, strategic product efforts. Express the most important streams of work in your company and how they are progressing.
Make strategic product work legible with Initiatives
Initiatives serve as a canonical entry point, aligning everyone on the most important product efforts in your company.
Provide a detailed summary for each initiative and link to resources and related documents.
Quickly see if your initiatives are on track
and identify any projects blocking progress.
Align your team around a unified product timeline. Plan visually with dynamic planning features, designed to help product teams ship.
Stay up to date on what’s happening across your product organization with a personalized feed of updates and discussions.
A personalized feed for what’s happening across your company
Pulse brings relevant updates from across your Linear workspace into a single unified feed tailored to the workstreams that are most important to you.
Narrow in on what’s most relevant
Create custom Pulse feeds to focus on a targeted subset of project and initiative updates.
AI summaries, delivered to your inbox
Receive a personal AI-generated update summary in your Linear inbox, available as text or a short audio digest.
Take the guesswork out of product planning with Linear’s purpose-built analytics, reporting, and dashboard features.
Instant analytics for any stream of work
Building truly great products is both art and science. It’s part intuition and part data. To help with the data part, Linear offers a variety of advanced analytics features.
to monitor and understand key metrics.
Export Linear data to Google Sheets,
Fivetran, or Airbyte for deeper analysis.
Plan and navigate from idea to launch
Agents that follow work from conversation to code
Move work forward across teams and agents
Linear Projects give us a source-of-truth across all our work and keeps the team in-sync.
For the first time ever we have a singular, unified roadmap.
Linear powers over 40,000 product teams. From ambitious startups to major enterprises.
Built for the future. Available today.
